Verbatim: "M/s LNG Easy (Private) Limited has been granted a construction license to develop the project; the company has yet to take a Final Investment Decision (FID)." This is the SAME passage (verified via url_verifier PASS on 'LNG Easy', 'Energas', 'Tabeer', 'construction license') that describes Energas and Tabeer -- both of which GEM already carries as 'proposed' despite years without FID. GEM's prior 'shelved (inferred 2y)' call for LNG Easy was based on absence of news, not a confirmed abandonment; this primary source shows the OGRA construction license (granted 2023-07-27 per OGRA notices) remains active and the company is still a live licensee as of the FY2026 survey. Reverting to 'proposed' for consistency with its identically-situated peers.
